name: Rocaille Cartouche
desc: An asymmetric rococo cartouche -- a tinted panel framed by an off-balance encrustation of C-scrolls, S-scrolls, a scallop shell and foliate sprigs, weighted heavier at the top-left and bottom-right as the style demands; everything is modelled gilt, and a broad band of gilding shimmer sweeps diagonally across the whole piece so the frozen frame breathes with reflected light, rendered as Sevres-blue gilt, white bisque porcelain, painted boiserie, or an ornament-print engraving.

scale.doc: size of the panel and its scroll frame -- fills more of the screen

speed.doc: how fast the shimmer band sweeps and the scrolls breathe

density.doc: number of scroll and sprig elements around the frame

sway.doc: how much the ornament breathes / uncurls

style.doc: aesthetic: Sevres-blue panel with gold / white bisque porcelain relief / painted-and-gilt boiserie / monochrome ornament-print engraving

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-throws scroll placement, shell and asymmetry
